title: a16z Podcast: Fintech for the People

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: New fintech companies are democratizing access to financial services in different ways, whether it's making food stamps more efficient.
reader_summary.overview: New fintech companies are democratizing access to financial services in different ways, whether it's making food stamps more efficient. But what these all have in common -- besides a more inclusive approach to finance -- is also changing, in some way. Featuring CEO of Propel Jimmy Chen, CEO of Branch Matt Flannery, and CEO of Earnin Ram Palaniappan, in conversation with a16z partner Angela Strange.
